sm: Steve Deace argues the president broke covenant with his base, comparing it to George H. W. Bush's tax increase, Clinton's 1994 losses, and Bush's 2006 midterm defeat. He says that if the president reinvents himself and lifts his approval into the mid-40s, Republicans can win in 2028. Otherwise, he warns, Democrats could win, even with someone like Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.
